page.overview:
Who is Agent Trace?

Agent Trace is a character in the Agents series. She is featured in four sets, including one in Agents 2.0.

She is specialized in security, code decryption, and secret undercover missions. Although she is a capable agent, she serves the role of the damsel in distress in Mission 4.

Security, decryption and undercover-mission specialist.
